raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Scope

Adds an opt-in experimental gfx950 eager-decode kernel for MiMo-V2 dense MLPs. It fuses SwiGLU, per-128 FP8 activation quantization, and the FP8 blockscale down projection without materializing the activated intermediate tensor.

Enabled only with `VLLM_ROCM_MIMO_MONO_MLP=1`; requires gfx950, TP1/TP8, BF16 activations, FP8 E4M3 weights with FP32 128x128 scales, eager execution, M<=16, and non-preshuffled down weights. All other cases retain the current path.

## Validation

- `ruff check` passed on changed sources.
- Real gfx950 TP8 MiMo-V2.6-Pro server reached the experimental path on all ranks: local gate `(4,4096)`, weight `(6144,2048)`, scale `(48,16)`.
- Focused blockscale numeric test passed for TP8 local shard.
- Synthetic M=1 local-shard GPU timing: 0.0300 ms mono vs 0.0430 ms staged AITER activation-quant plus blockscale GEMM. This is not an end-to-end throughput claim.
- GSM8K 8-question five-shot smoke: 1.000 accuracy, 0 invalid; it is not a full evaluation.

## Limits

The kernel recomputes SwiGLU per N=128 output tile to remove the activated tensor. It is intentionally experimental; graph capture and unsupported layouts fall back.

AI assistance was used for implementation and validation.

## Full Model Before/After (2026-10-23)

Exact Python source head `227d5518892b996aca814a08841bdec2e797be9f`, OFF/ON using `VLLM_ROCM_MIMO_MONO_MLP=0/1`; other launch arguments and recorded environment values were identical. No source fix was applied to this PR during the measurement. Image-provided vLLM native extensions were retained.

Full MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL, TP8/DP1, eager, ordinary AITER routed experts, BF16 model/KV, TRITON_ATTN, context4096, scheduled tokens256, max sequences32, chunked prefill, no prefix caching or speculation. The candidate is the dense-MLP mono kernel, not TP MegaMoE.

### Full GSM8K

All 1319 test questions, 5-shot repository prompts/scorer, completions endpoint, temperature0, seed42, max_tokens1024, concurrency16. Every raw HTTP response was retained. Both runs were independently rescored and paired on indices, labels, prompt hashes, request-payload hashes and prompt token counts. No retries or exclusions; invalid answers count incorrect, and truncated responses remain in the denominator.

| Metric | Baseline | Mono ON |
|---|---:|---:|
| Correct / questions | 1213/1319 | 1231/1319 |
| Accuracy | 91.9636% | 93.3283% |
| Request failures | 0 | 0 |
| Empty answers | 1 | 1 |
| Invalid answers (including empty) | 1 | 1 |
| Length-truncated responses | 1 | 0 |
| Generated tokens | 162329 | 160702 |

Observed candidate delta: +18 correct answers / +1.3647 percentage points. One full run per configuration is not an accuracy-equivalence or general no-regression proof.

Paired outcomes: 1188 both correct, 63 both wrong, 25 baseline-only correct, 43 candidate-only correct.

Baseline responses SHA256: `a30d24d794b580e5abdd483ce59f7648bf55b98995acff2c9583b3001d782543`.
Candidate responses SHA256: `46d39af49aa07dc508842a4ce781c0c362ea8c14cc88c3f1fb318508d0906021`.

### Serving Performance

Standard vLLM bench serve, fixed random 1024-token input / 256-token output, temperature0, ignore EOS, infinite offered rate, seeds42/43/44. Each sample has max(32,4*C) measured requests after max(8,C) warmups. All measured request lengths and raw result hashes were verified.

| Concurrency | OFF output tok/s | ON output tok/s | Paired speedup median | Range |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 15.706 | 15.630 | 0.995x | 0.991-1.001x |
| 8 | 104.290 | 102.943 | 0.987x | 0.985-1.003x |
| 16 | 200.633 | 198.717 | 0.990x | 0.957-1.002x |
| 32 | 380.665 | 383.851 | 1.009x | 0.997-1.014x |

Throughput columns are three-sample medians; speedups are same-seed paired ratios. The OFF and ON arms were sequential, not randomized. Clocks were not locked; small differences must not be promoted as a reproducible gain. C32 is an out-of-range control for steady M>16 decode: the mono contract falls back above 16 rows, although draining batches can become eligible.

The ON log records actual experimental mono-kernel launches; the OFF log has none. This log does not measure total eligible/fallback call counts. These are eager results, not model CUDA Graph validation or production-wide gains.

### Environment And Limits

Image `sha256:e10e6f7ba67610f3118d8b67fc2fbeefb348b30fff53c399eed41e9efc0c0ae5`; Python `3.12.15`, PyTorch `2.13.0+git733fca1`, HIP `7.2.53211`, FlyDSL `0.3.4.1`.

Inference-time error checks passed for these runs. Post-measurement worker cleanup is reported separately below; absence of request errors is not proof of clean teardown.

- mono-off: worker SIGKILL=True, EngineDeadError=True, semaphore warning=True; server-log SHA256 `862a36a74ed5e725bfdddc025b48adc761d8c2953afa7d1d0aee7cb16a0495d8`.
- mono-on: worker SIGKILL=True, EngineDeadError=True, semaphore warning=True; server-log SHA256 `4f4aa8f7e68e943868401201003e1b1c92b63b7228d54e32b7584477ed436b9e`.

AI assistance was used for test orchestration and evidence review.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("intermediate", [2048, 16384])
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not torch.cuda.is_available() or not current_platform.is_rocm(),
+    reason="requires a ROCm GPU",
+)
+def test_mimo_mono_mlp_matches_blockscale_reference(intermediate: int):
+    device = "cuda"
+    gate_up = torch.randn((1, 2 * intermediate), device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    down_weight = torch.randn((6144, intermediate), device=device).to(
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    )
+    down_scale = (
+        torch.rand((48, intermediate // 128), device=device, dtype=torch.float32) + 0.01
+    )
+
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.triton.mimo_mono_mlp import (
+        can_use_mimo_fp8_mono_mlp,
+        mimo_fp8_mono_mlp,
+    )
+
+    assert can_use_mimo_fp8_mono_mlp(
+        gate_up,
+        down_weight,
+        down_scale,
+        tensor_parallel_size=8 if intermediate == 2048 else 1,
+        is_capturing=False,
+    )
+    actual = mimo_fp8_mono_mlp(gate_up, down_weight, down_scale)
+    activation = torch.nn.functional.silu(gate_up[:, :intermediate].float())
+    activation *= gate_up[:, intermediate:].float()
+    activation_scale = activation.view(1, intermediate // 128, 128).abs().amax(-1)
+    activation_scale = activation_scale.clamp_min(1e-10) / 448.0
+    activation_q = (
+        (activation.view(1, intermediate // 128, 128) / activation_scale[..., None])
+        .clamp(-448.0, 448.0)
+        .to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    )
+    expected = torch.zeros((1, 6144), device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    for n in range(0, 6144, 128):
+        for k in range(0, intermediate, 128):
+            expected[:, n : n + 128] += (
+                activation_q[:, k // 128].float()
+                @ down_weight[n : n + 128, k : k + 128].float().T
+                * activation_scale[:, k // 128 : k // 128 + 1]
+                * down_scale[n // 128, k // 128]
+            )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual.float(), expected, rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2)

@@ -0,0 +1,137 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Experimental gfx950 MiMo dense-MPL mono kernel.
+
+The kernel fuses SwiGLU, dynamic FP8 group-128 activation quantization and the
+block-scaled FP8 down projection. It consumes the checkpoint's unshuffled
+``[N, K]`` E4M3 weights and ``[N/128, K/128]`` FP32 dequant scales.
+
+One output tile recomputes the SwiGLU activation. This is deliberate: it avoids
+materializing the ``[M, 16384]`` activation but trades redundant gate/up reads
+for output parallelism. It is an experimental decode kernel, not a claim that
+it improves the production AITER path.
+"""
+
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+_HIDDEN = 6144
+_INTERMEDIATE = 16384
+_BLOCK = 128
+_MAX_ROWS = 16
+
+_LOGGER = init_logger(__name__)
+_logged = False
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _mimo_fp8_mono_mlp_kernel(
+    gate_up_ptr,
+    weight_ptr,
+    weight_scale_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    rows,
+    weight_stride_n,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    HIDDEN: tl.constexpr,
+    INTERMEDIATE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    tile_n = tl.program_id(1)
+    n = tile_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    k = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_N,), dtype=tl.float32)
+
+    for block_k in tl.static_range(0, INTERMEDIATE, BLOCK_K):
+        offset_k = block_k + k
+        gate = tl.load(gate_up_ptr + row * (2 * INTERMEDIATE) + offset_k).to(tl.float32)
+        up = tl.load(
+            gate_up_ptr + row * (2 * INTERMEDIATE) + INTERMEDIATE + offset_k
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        activation = gate * tl.sigmoid(gate) * up
+        scale = tl.maximum(tl.max(tl.abs(activation), axis=0), 1e-10) / 448.0
+        activation_fp8 = tl.clamp(activation / scale, -448.0, 448.0).to(
+            weight_ptr.dtype.element_ty
+        )
+        weight = tl.load(
+            weight_ptr + n[:, None] * weight_stride_n + offset_k[None, :],
+            mask=n[:, None] < HIDDEN,
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        weight_scale = tl.load(
+            weight_scale_ptr
+            + (n // BLOCK_K) * (INTERMEDIATE // BLOCK_K)
+            + (block_k // BLOCK_K),
+            mask=n < HIDDEN,
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        acc += tl.sum(
+            weight.to(tl.float32) * activation_fp8[None, :].to(tl.float32), axis=1
+        ) * (scale * weight_scale)
+
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + row * HIDDEN + n,
+        acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+        mask=n < HIDDEN,
+    )
+
+
+def can_use_mimo_fp8_mono_mlp(
+    gate_up: Tensor,
+    down_weight: Tensor,
+    down_scale: Tensor,
+    *,
+    tensor_parallel_size: int,
+    is_capturing: bool,
+) -> bool:
+    """Return whether the explicit experimental layout contract is met."""
+    return (
+        not is_capturing
+        and tensor_parallel_size in (1, 8)
+        and gate_up.device.type == "cuda"
+        and gate_up.dtype is torch.bfloat16
+        and down_weight.dtype in (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e4m3fnuz)
+        and down_scale.dtype is torch.float32
+        and gate_up.ndim == down_weight.ndim == down_scale.ndim == 2
+        and 0 < gate_up.shape[0] <= _MAX_ROWS
+        and gate_up.shape[1] == 2 * down_weight.shape[1]
+        and down_weight.shape[0] == _HIDDEN
+        and down_weight.shape[1] % _BLOCK == 0
+        and down_scale.shape == (_HIDDEN // _BLOCK, down_weight.shape[1] // _BLOCK)
+        and gate_up.is_contiguous()
+        and down_weight.stride(1) == 1
+        and down_weight.stride(0) >= down_weight.shape[1]
+        and down_scale.is_contiguous()
+    )
+
+
+def mimo_fp8_mono_mlp(
+    gate_up: Tensor, down_weight: Tensor, down_scale: Tensor
+) -> Tensor:
+    """Launch the experimental one-kernel MiMo SwiGLU/down projection."""
+    global _logged
+    if not _logged:
+        _LOGGER.info("Using experimental MiMo FP8 blockscale mono MLP")
+        _logged = True
+    output = torch.empty(
+        (gate_up.shape[0], _HIDDEN), dtype=gate_up.dtype, device=gate_up.device
+    )
+    intermediate = down_weight.shape[1]
+    _mimo_fp8_mono_mlp_kernel[(gate_up.shape[0], _HIDDEN // _BLOCK)](
+        gate_up,
+        down_weight,
+        down_scale,
+        output,
+        gate_up.shape[0],
+        down_weight.stride(0),
+        BLOCK_N=_BLOCK,
+        HIDDEN=_HIDDEN,
+        INTERMEDIATE=intermediate,
+        BLOCK_K=_BLOCK,
+        num_warps=4,
+    )
+    return output

 from torch import nn
 
+import vllm.envs as envs
 from vllm.compilation.decorators import support_torch_compile
 from vllm.config import (
     CacheConfig,
@@ -19,6 +20,7 @@
     get_tensor_model_parallel_rank,
     get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size,
     tensor_model_parallel_all_gather,
+    tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce,
 )
 from vllm.logger import init_logger
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.activation import SiluAndMul
@@ -107,8 +109,63 @@ def __init__(
             )
         self.act_fn = SiluAndMul()
 
+    def _can_use_mono_kernel(self, gate_up: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+        if not envs.VLLM_ROCM_MIMO_MONO_MLP:
+            return False
+        from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+        if not on_gfx950():
+            return False
+        from vllm.model_executor.kernels.triton.mimo_mono_mlp import (
+            can_use_mimo_fp8_mono_mlp,
+        )
+
+        if getattr(self.down_proj, "aiter_bpreshuffled", False):
+            return False
+        return can_use_mimo_fp8_mono_mlp(
+            gate_up,
+            self.down_proj.weight,
+            self.down_proj.weight_scale_inv,
+            tensor_parallel_size=self.gate_up_proj.tp_size,
+            is_capturing=torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing(),
+        )
+
     def forward(self, x):
         gate_up, _ = self.gate_up_proj(x)
+        eligible = self._can_use_mono_kernel(gate_up)
+        if envs.VLLM_ROCM_MIMO_MONO_MLP:
+            logger.info_once(
+                "MiMo mono MLP: eligible=%s compiling=%s gate=%s/%s/%s weight=%s/%s/%s "
+                "scale=%s/%s/%s weight_dtype=%s scale_dtype=%s preshuffled=%s tp=%s",
+                eligible,
+                torch.compiler.is_compiling(),
+                tuple(gate_up.shape),
+                tuple(gate_up.stride()),
+                gate_up.is_contiguous(),
+                tuple(self.down_proj.weight.shape),
+                tuple(self.down_proj.weight.stride()),
+                self.down_proj.weight.is_contiguous(),
+                tuple(self.down_proj.weight_scale_inv.shape),
+                tuple(self.down_proj.weight_scale_inv.stride()),
+                self.down_proj.weight_scale_inv.is_contiguous(),
+                self.down_proj.weight.dtype,
+                self.down_proj.weight_scale_inv.dtype,
+                getattr(self.down_proj, "aiter_bpreshuffled", False),
+                self.gate_up_proj.tp_size,
+            )
+        if not torch.compiler.is_compiling() and eligible:
+            from vllm.model_executor.kernels.triton.mimo_mono_mlp import (
+                mimo_fp8_mono_mlp,
+            )
+
+            output = mimo_fp8_mono_mlp(
+                gate_up,
+                self.down_proj.weight,
+                self.down_proj.weight_scale_inv,
+            )
+            if self.down_proj.reduce_results and self.down_proj.tp_size > 1:
+                output = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(output)
+            return output
         x = self.act_fn(gate_up)
         x, _ = self.down_proj(x)
         return x
